Consumer Protection Bureau of Consumer Protection housing Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Privacy and Security Credit Reporting

The Federal Trade Commission and the Department of Justice took action against RentGrow, Inc. The complaint alleges the company violated the Fair Credit Reporting Act by failing to follow reasonable procedures. RentGrow will pay $2.25 million in civil penalties and is required to establish an accuracy program.
